notes: Bushido's hl2 ammo system and hitbox test, shared by both releases of his Adventurer's Weapons (Support_AmmoSystem.cs and Support_Hitbox.cs in Weapon_ModernWarbattles and Glass 1019's Weapon_AdventurePack).

handles.gameConnection::onDeath: the ammo display: the engine hides it when its holder dies, as no gun is out
handles.serverCmdDropTool: a dropped gun keeps the rounds in its magazine (the weapons runtime's drops)
handles.ItemData::onAdd: a dropped gun keeps the rounds in its magazine (the weapons runtime's drops)
handles.Player::pickUp: a dropped gun gives its rounds back to whoever picks it up, and a new one comes full (the weapons runtime's drops)
handles.Armor::onCollision: the host rules' on_pickup: ammo boxes, and spare guns from spawn bricks, top up the reserve
handles.matchBodyArea: the hitbox test: the engine tells a head hit from a body hit, which the host rules' on_damage reads for headshotMultiplier and the flinch
